verdict.rationale: EBANX documents payment notifications sent as HTTP POST requests to a configured Notification URL, with a digital signature in the headers, and says it retries failed deliveries multiple times. That covers signed delivery and automatic retries. Nothing in the pack shows a delivery event log or a way to replay notifications. Missing for 10: webhook event/delivery logs, manual or programmatic replay of notifications, retry schedule details, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can rely on signed webhook deliveries with automatic retries, event logs, and replay to keep my system consistent with payment state

citations.quote: EBANX sends an HTTP POST request to the configured Notification URL. The request includes basic payment and status information, along with headers containing a digital signature
If your system fails to process a notification (e.g., due to a server error), EBANX will retry sending it multiple times.
